verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Rules v2 lets you define authorization-time rules on MCC (and country, currency, risk score) at the program, account, or card level, which covers MCC-based restrictions applied during authorization. The blog also cites rules 'controlling merchant categories'. ASA custom decisioning is a developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit allowlist vs blocklist semantics for MCC rules, documented single-merchant lock (e.g., merchant-locked cards or merchant ID rules), independent or hands-on corroboration.
